title: The Quiet Yearbook
author: Cyrus Ravensworth
blurb: Wren Vane, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, has spent twelve years being so careful it hurts. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
